analysis:
The PR changes only two test files. VLMDecodeBombTests.swift line 202 now matches `image.source` instead of `image`. MiMoV26EncodedMediaIngressTests.swift line 560 now matches `ingested.video.source` instead of `ingested.video`. Both edits adapt tests to a media-ingest return type that now wraps the decoded image/video in a struct with a `.source` field. The production definition of that wrapper is not supplied in this batch, so I could not check it directly.

I found no changes to production code, key handling, attestation, coordinator-to-provider encryption, prefix cache (T-041), or authorization paths. The decompression-bomb tests (VLMDecodeBombTests) still exercise header-based pixel-count rejection through `MediaIngest.decodeImage`, `buildUserInput`, and `imagePixelCount`. The assertions that reject `mediaTooLarge` before decode are unchanged, so test coverage of that guard is not weakened. The memory-backed video test still verifies the same ingest path, `.memoryBacked` ownership, and the authenticated native route.

Open integration questions: the production MediaIngest change (the wrapper type around image/video) is outside this batch. A reviewer should confirm that the wrapper does not alter the order of the pixel-cap check relative to the raster decode, that the aggregate-pixel charge still precedes decode, and that video temporary-file handling (T-050) is preserved. No security regression is evident from the supplied test-only diff.
